complexity.notes: Clean, idiomatic one-liner-style solution. Trades the previous version's constant extra working space for an O(n) filtered copy plus an O(n) reversed copy; the comparison itself short-circuits at the first mismatch, but the two copies are always built in full.
complexity.summary: Builds a filtered lowercase string of only the alphanumeric characters, then checks whether it equals its own reverse via slicing.
